intro: Taming the Beast is a hunter training lesson overseen by Josephine Carson. After learning the fundamentals of beast handling with a boar, the aspiring hunter must use a Taming Rod to earn the trust of a fiercer Gray Forest Wolf.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You've already mastered taming a boar. Now it's time for the next lesson. The forest holds fiercer companions, and with care, you can earn their trust.
Take this Taming Rod and seek out a Gray Forest Wolf. Remember, nature's balance must be respected. Prove your skill as an adventurer once more.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done, friend! You're quite in tune with the beast.

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
